body:
Reciently i was perscribed Alprazolam to calm my nerves for a dentist appointment which usually were a great stress. I was given a few .5MG pills. Weeks after the appointment i still had a couple left and decided to use one to help me sleep. As usual after taking it i felt calm and somewhat tired. Falling asleep i experienced a very vivid dream involving river rafting in Asia and assasins in hovercrafts. Although i would not classify it as scary or a nightmere it was almost disturbing how real it seemed for a dream. Overall it was not a bad experience its just one i would not perfer to have again.
